cba.banner_text: Every 2027 figure is a 2022 CBA carry-forward: the agreement expires 2026-12-01 and no threshold, league minimum, arbitration structure or qualifying-offer value past it has been published. Where Spotrac uses a different 2027 basis the page prints both, each labelled.

copy.masthead: Every dollar a club has on the books, from Spotrac and our own models, and what each dollar is projected to buy. No revenue, valuations or TV money.
copy.league_lede: Thirty clubs on two Spotrac bases and the platform's own prices. Only Cost+ and OrgSur+ take a colour; every dollar cell prints plain, and the league average row is a reference, never a club.
copy.footer_means_note: The two rows differ by $18.0M because Spotrac's league average is the page's average row as fetched 2026-07-07, while the 30 club rows were refetched 2026-10-02; the basis is the same (Spotrac total payroll allocations 2027), so the gap is 2027 money that reached club books between the two fetches.
copy.club_foot: Descriptive ledger. No single projected payroll is served: contract dollars on file, projected arbitration steps and rule minimums are three keys the page never sums.
copy.cba_banner: Every 2027 figure is a 2022 CBA carry-forward: the agreement expires 2026-12-01 and no threshold, league minimum, arbitration structure or qualifying-offer value past it has been published. Where Spotrac uses a different 2027 basis the page prints both, each labelled.
copy.cbt_computed_label: computed from Spotrac tax payroll and the 2022 CBA schedule (cba_rules.json)
copy.cbt_clock_rule: the rate resets to first-time after one full season under the threshold; rule text, not a forecast
copy.cbt_verify_note: Every CBA rule on file is hand-entered and unverified; the 2027 threshold is unknown
copy.qo_recipient_note: which clubs receive revenue sharing is not sourceable here; that QO pick tax tier is a league value only
copy.cbt_spotrac_surcharges_only: Spotrac's 2027 estimate equals the surcharges alone on its 247M basis, to the dollar; it carries no base rate, which the computed bill does
copy.tax_floor_note: Spotrac's 2027 tax payroll sits below the AAV of this club's own guaranteed 2027 contract rows (club and mutual option years left out), so the larger figure, the guaranteed AAV, stands in for it in the 2027 space, the 2027 CBT block, Cost+ and the $ per projected win and WAR; Spotrac's own figure prints beside it.
copy.split_2026_note: the 2026 Spotrac payroll page carries no active / injured / retained / buried split; the strip is drawn for 2027 only
copy.allocations_note: CBT payroll is Spotrac's AAV basis; total payroll allocations are Spotrac's cash basis
copy.history_blocked_on: Payroll history is cached but not yet ingested: 2026-2027 is on file; the 2016-2025 Spotrac pages are not backfilled

commitments_bases.contract: Contract dollars on file (Spotrac, never re-priced)
commitments_bases.prearb: Pre-arb minimums by rule (780,000 per PRE-ARB season, salary_path.LEAGUE_MIN_CURATED[2026] carried forward)

copy.commitments_not_summed: three labelled segments and a count of unpriced vets; no key sums them into a payroll, because that sum would be a forecast without a registry row
copy.horizon_label: half of today's contract dollars roll off by
copy.expiring_basis: fa_class members from this club; projected guarantees are sums of means and the P10-P90 band is shown per player in the free agency block
holes: every 2027+ arbitration step is a 2022 CBA carry-forward past the 2026-12-01 expiry, and no interval covers that
the class token is inferred rather than read from published service time on most board rows, and class closure uses it twice, once for the rung and once for the horizon
arb-2+ is a served null (an empirical step multiplier beat the model), and closure runs that same multiplier one to two rungs further
window length is a property of Spotrac's grid depth, so two comparable players can carry two and four priced seasons for no baseball reason
copy.options_note: Options on file: hand-entered from contract stamps and Spotrac contract years (Spotrac's years remaining excludes options).
copy.deferral_rate_label: NPV at the platform 7 pct rate
copy.deferral_coverage: covered deals only: every guarantee of 200M or more has an entry (audited into fa_gate2_eval.deferral_coverage); this is not a complete club deferral ledger
copy.deferral_rate_note: the platform discounts at 7 pct, which differs from the CBT statutory rate, so these NPVs read lower than league-reported figures
copy.dead_money_blocked_on: Spotrac's dataTable-dead rows carry no table_id on the read side yet (spotrac._parse_team_contract_table); the tag trails v1 so the priced contract set cannot widen by accident
copy.dead_money_beside: Spotrac 2027 buried allocation, a different table with an overlapping definition; never summed with dead money
copy.retained_blocked_on: Spotrac's dataTable-retained rows carry no table_id on the read side yet; retained obligations are never merged into the employing club's AAV
copy.arb_tender_note: Not a payroll forecast: assumes every player is tendered; a non-tender lowers the figure. Extensions are absent
copy.arb_provisional: provisional: the arb-1 model is gated, arb-2+ is a population multiplier
copy.arb_flag_key: flag bits: 1 step not from published service time, 2 step from the debut heuristic, 4 no salary on file, 8 past the CBA expiry, 16 2020 prorated, 32 status order repaired (a Spotrac status that put a later season in a lower arbitration class was rewritten), 64 an arbitration rung floored at 80% of the signed salary the season before (CBA maximum cut)
copy.arb_realized_title: What arbitration cost, and what it bought
copy.arb_realized_copy: Realized value, not skill: what arbitration paid and what the seasons returned. The counterfactual, what the club would have paid had it settled or gone to a hearing differently, is not observed.
copy.ou_mkt: vs market: actual minus this model; what arbitration paid against comparables. Sums to roughly zero by construction.
copy.ou_war: actual minus WAR (fWAR basis) priced at that season's dollars per win. Does not sum to zero, because arbitration systematically pays below the open market.
copy.never_combine: The two residuals measure different things and are never averaged or summed.
copy.surplus_basis: MLB leg: MLB Projections surNpv at dpw 16,856,777 (2027 ex-ante), 5-season horizon, every guaranteed season past 2031 priced too, on the champion aging curve chained from the 2031 WAR, 7 pct discount, usd converted to $M; farm leg: org_summary active surplus ($M, prospect_surplus validated), priced at the same 16,856,777 per WAR (one level for prospect and veteran surplus since 2026-09-25). Both legs in $M before the sum.
copy.surplus_no_tier: a club total sits above the player-row surplus ladder's top cut nearly everywhere, so it prints plain
copy.surplus_ev: Sur+ sums are sums of expected values; quantiles are never summed
copy.trade_currency_basis: Trade Machine currency (trade_machine_surplus provisional); overlaps the MLB and farm legs by construction and is never added to them
copy.trajectory_note: since late June, no earlier history
copy.ratio_bases: the three Cost+ denominator parts over team_win_projections 2027 wins (provisional) less the 2027 WAR of the club's locked free agents
copy.cost_plus_basis: descriptive index, not a model: projected 2027 WAR, less the 2027 WAR of the club's locked free agents, per $M of three parts printed beside it and never added into one payroll figure: guaranteed 2027 salaries (Spotrac's 2027 CBT payroll, or the club's own guaranteed contract AAV where that is larger), the platform's projected 2027 arbitration awards and the pre-arbitration minimum rungs. The index runs mostly as an inverse cost rank: Spearman 0.86 against minus the three parts together and 0.17 against projected WAR less the locked free agents across 30 clubs
copy.cost_plus_numerator_label: Projected 2027 WAR less locked free agents
copy.cost_plus_parts_note: the three parts print apart and are never added into a payroll figure; a rung for a player whose 2027 salary is already a contract on file is left out of the arbitration parts, since the guaranteed part carries it
copy.cost_plus_registry: no registry row: Cost+ predicts nothing; a skill claim would need an eval first

fin_contract_surplus.basis: usd per year: current AAV minus bonus amortized over six years, graduates

fin_draft_pool_efficiency.basis: WAR per $M of draft pool in window

fin_ifa_roi.basis: WAR per $M of IFA bonus, eight-season window

copy.farm_letters_note: letters come from org_summary.grades (rank across 30 orgs) and are never recomputed; a sparse leaf prints a dash
copy.pools_note: 2021 holds nine clubs (parser miss on the MLB.com article); 2027 pools are not published
copy.slot_coverage_basis: share of the league's draft_results rows for that year carrying slot_usd
copy.pool_used_basis: bonuses on the round 1-10 slotted picks over the published pool, which is the sum of those slot values; the Paid column also counts rounds 11 and later, which carry no slot, and the part of their bonuses above the CBA threshold sits in its own column, not in Pool used
copy.r11_over_basis: the part of each round 11 or later bonus above the CBA threshold for its draft year ($125,000 for the 2017 to 2021 drafts; $150,000 for the 2022 to 2026 drafts; cba_rules, through fa_cba), summed, with the number of such picks; the CBA charges it to the bonus pool. The 2020 draft ran 5 rounds, so it has no such pick
copy.r11_threshold_schedule: CBA threshold: $125,000 for the 2017 to 2021 drafts; $150,000 for the 2022 to 2026 drafts
copy.pick_war_label: expected first-6 WAR of the 2027 first-round pick (draft_slot_curve, validated; on the projected slot, not lottery-weighted)
copy.pick_war_why: the lottery snapshot carries the odds of pick 1 and of a top-6 pick, not the full odds vector, so the expectation is on the projected slot
copy.pick_dollars: pick dollars are not served: the only in-repo pick pricing is the QO tax method
copy.ifa_implied_basis: implied from Spotrac pool percentages, not a published allocation
copy.ifa_history_blocked_on: IFA classes 2009-2018 are cached but run_monthly caps the range at 2021; extending it is a cache-only ingest deferred past v1, and 2019-2020 pages are not on disk
copy.fits_note: fa_team_fit is provisional: gate-3 MRR .165 against random .133
copy.implied_dpw_note: the club's implied dollars per WAR is not on the archive rows (projected WAR at signing is not stored), so only the league rate prints
copy.realized_title: Contract value delivered (realized, elapsed seasons only)
copy.realized_sentence: This is what the contracts returned, not how well the club chose them. The counterfactual, what the same dollars would have bought elsewhere that winter, is not observed, so no club is ranked by it.
copy.realized_coverage: covered signings carry the realized block; a winter carries none until its first season is played and the ledger is rebuilt after the regular season (once a year)
copy.realized_not_skill: Realized value, not skill: what happened after the money was spent, with the counterfactual unobserved.
copy.no_payroll_line: A single projected payroll is not served: it would need registry row club_payroll_path and the 2016-2025 payroll history as labels.
copy.load_error: Club Ledger did not load. Retry.
copy.arb_dpw_basis: arbitration dollars per WAR 2026 (arbitration.json dpw) over the open-market rate for winter 2026 (fa_dpw_series)
copy.projections_dpw_basis: mlb_projections dpw_usd, 2027 ex-ante, the surplus pricing rate
copy.league_minimum_note: salary_path.LEAGUE_MIN_CURATED; seasons past 2026 carry the last value forward by rule
copy.farm_dollar_is_template: A farm dollar here is an expected value: the eFV expected surplus of an active prospect, in millions, on the clemens_2026 valuation set (its tier shape at the one free-agent $/WAR level the MLB leg also prices at) over its own seven-season window, priced through the platform's calibrated engine (calibration {calibration_version}, prospect_surplus validated on data/surplus_backtest_real.json). It is the mean of a distribution whose 10th and 90th percentiles print on the row. Net of the signing bonus it is what the club roll-up sums.
copy.farm_dollar_is_not: It is not a trade price (the Trade Machine re-anchors debuted players and adds a roster crunch), not a quantile, and not a realized figure: no farm dollar has been earned. The MLB Projections board prints this same eFV surplus for the prospects it carries and does not reprice them. Quantiles on these rows are never summed, and a row's number is never added to a number on another basis.
copy.farm_reconcile: The roll-up leaf is the sum over active prospects of eFV expected surplus minus the signing bonus on file, computed inside the PROSPX org summary. The rows below carry the same two quantities from the trade board export and the PROSPX prospect rows; their sum is printed beside the leaf with both artifacts' stamps.
copy.farm_vintage_gap: The leaf and the rows were written at different points of the same nightly, and eFV surplus moves nightly; a gap inside the tolerance is vintage drift, not a disagreement about any prospect.
copy.farm_gap_broken: The rows do not reconcile to the leaf beyond the tolerance. Both figures are shown; neither is corrected.
copy.farm_no_bonus: A prospect with no bonus on file counts a cost of zero in the leaf and in these rows; the count is printed beside every cost figure. Most such rows are international signings whose bonus the pipeline never captured.
copy.trade_cost_dark: What a trade cost is the value given up, in FV and surplus, not dollars; no cost basis exists for the trade channel and none is invented. The Trade Machine prices the exchange.
copy.grad_dev_credit: Graduates are listed by the club that developed them, not the club they play for now: Share is this club's development share (the value at signing to the signing club, the grade growth during each club's tenure to that club), and Now with is his current club. Accounting, not a causal estimate.
copy.grad_two_engines: Two engines price a graduate: debuted_player_value (PROSPX debuted rows) and the trade board's posterior. Each prints under its own name; they are never averaged or summed.
copy.grad_contract_dark: Grad-Contract Surplus is served as the org mean only (current AAV minus the bonus amortized over six years). No per-graduate row is exported; one recomputed here would be a new number with no registry row.
copy.grad_contract_formula: per graduate with both a current AAV and a bonus on file: AAV minus bonus over six; the org mean and its n are the leaf, which is why n is smaller than the graduate count
copy.grad_no_registry: debuted_player_value carries no registry row of its own; its parent prospect_surplus is validated. Read the debuted column as a served number without its own eval.
copy.shard_failed: The per-club rows did not load; the preview above is the board's.
copy.shard_vintage: These rows were written against a different board build than the one on screen.
copy.dvm_within_tier: $DvM+ is 100 + 10z of the prospect's grade pace (eFV change per year, consensus FV where eFV has no history, plus half his years young for level) against his current eFV tier, with no clamp, so a value below 40 or above 160 is the model's own reading: not on the league z pool, not a dollar figure, unvalidated.
copy.p_bust_basis: P(bust) on the eFV row is the retired realized_implied map (ground-truthed there); the MLB Projections prospect row's pBust is a different curve and prints only under its own label.
copy.preview_note: top rows by expected surplus; the full farm ledger loads per club
copy.grad_preview_note: the graduate rows load per club
copy.arb_preview_note: the class-year rung per row; the full ladder and the realized rows load per club
copy.trade_preview_note: the debuted trade rows load per club
copy.paths_preview_note: the WAR and surplus strips load per club
copy.trajectory_active_basis: the actives of each snapshot, on that snapshot's own status, gross of bonuses; so it does not chart the leaf and a graduation moves it
copy.band_row_only: p10 to p90, eFV basis, per row only
copy.band_row_projection: p10 to p90, projection basis: every season the value prices at its own P10 and P90 WAR, salary held at the mean path, through the last guaranteed season (past 2031 the 2031 P10 and P90 chained along the champion aging curve, the P10 not floored at zero); per row only
copy.years_to_fa_dark: control not started; service time is a proxy on this site
copy.service_time_source: PROXY - the pipeline carries no service time. MLB appearance seasons on file (mlb_player_detail career block) upper-bound it; debuts.json roster_status.service_phase overrides where present.
copy.ifa_slot_dark: no slot: IFA is pool-percentage, see implied pool
copy.arb_prearb_rungs: board rows at the pre-arbitration minimum sit in this sum; the arbitration rungs alone are the first figure
copy.arb_two_populations: The stack above prices the club's priced veterans' salary paths; this bar sums the Arbitration Predictor's board rows for the same season. They overlap on the players both carry and differ on the rest; neither is added to the other and neither is a payroll.
copy.swartz_label_template: MLB Trade Rumors, Matt Swartz, published before settlement; present on {n_swartz} history rows, of which the a6 arm scored {n_a6} on identical rows
copy.swartz_a6: This model does not beat the MLB Trade Rumors / Matt Swartz projection. Measured on identical rows, Swartz is materially more accurate at every arbitration step. Reported as a NULL. The mechanism is not mysterious: Swartz prices the counting stats arbitration panels actually reward - home runs, RBI, saves, wins - and this champion deliberately excludes them because nothing in this pipeline projects them forward, which is what lets the same model serve a backtest and a forecast. Swartz is the better estimate of a KNOWN season; it is not available for an unplayed one.
copy.arb_quantiles_dark: P10 / P50 / P90 are not published: the band is the champion's MdAPE spread by rung and no per-rung residual quantiles exist
copy.arb_comps_dark: no comps are served; the champion is a ridge level model on log deflated salary (arb-1) and an empirical raise multiplier (arb-2+); a comps consumer must not read the contract set's aav_usd as a player's income (ARBITRATION_GATE 10)
copy.arb_filing_dark: filing figures and hearing outcomes are on no served row; svy is the service-time as-of season
copy.npv_identity: the served NPV discounts the unrounded per-season figures; the strip is rounded to 0.1M, so the two can differ by a few tens of thousands
copy.sur_total_identity: the rest-of-season leg is published to 0.1M and the total was built from the raw float; the printed equation can miss by a few tens of thousands
copy.sur_strip_basis: MLB Projections per-season surplus: convex tier pricing at the 2027 ex-ante FA $/WAR level, flat across seasons, minus the season's salary path cell; not war x $/WAR
copy.tv_reanchored: re-anchored on the trade board (archetype posterior floor); the projections figure is the contract row's
copy.prearb_min_floor: remaining pre-arb seasons plus the balance of the season in progress. This basis serves only the rows that carry no salary path at all: a row with one is priced over its whole club control window instead (salary_path, 2026-09-16). Where this basis does serve a row, the arbitration years the club also controls are NOT priced, so a prearb_min value is a FLOOR on the row's true club control window surplus.
copy.club_option_rule: a club option season the club would decline (salary above his value on the mean path) prices at $0, never below: declining is the club's right; an exercised club option prices as guaranteed salary, and player and mutual options are not club rights and keep their treatment
copy.opt_out_two_engines: player option seasons: the salary path prices them as guaranteed (opt-out not modelled, salary_path); the trade board's value folds an opt-out probability into this row (bayes_trade_value); the two are different numbers on purpose and neither is a served opt-out value
copy.trade_currency_split: the trade currency is the farm ledger's gross rows plus the debuted rows; it overlaps both legs and is never added to them
copy.shown_rows: shown rows: a sum of expected values
copy.sources_stamps: each block names the artifact and the build stamp it was read from
copy.registry_sentence: Provisional rows carry the registry verdict (Method tab); this page scores nothing itself.
copy.options_lede: Every pending club, player and mutual option and opt-out on this winter's free-agent class, with the salary at stake and the day the decision is due. Where the /fa/ export prices the option, its modelled value and P(exercise) print beside the terms; every other row prints the terms alone and says why.
copy.options_decision_rule: Decided in the 5 days after the 2026 World Series ends, the same window as the qualifying offer. The date shown is the latest the window can close: 5 days after the last scheduled postseason day (2026-10-31, MLB StatsAPI); a shorter Series moves it earlier, and a contract can name its own date, which no file here holds.
copy.options_p_exercise_basis: P(exercise) is the chance the holder uses the option: the club or the player picks up the year, or the player opts out. It is read off the /fa/ P(enter) (fa_penter, provisional): 1 minus P(enter) for a club or player option, P(enter) itself for an opt-out, priced from the option salary against the market model's predicted AAV band (for an opt-out, the remaining guarantee against the predicted guarantee). No option decision has scored it yet.
copy.options_value_basis: Option value is the /fa/ export's modelled worth of the option to the side that holds it, an expectation over the same band; on a player option or opt-out the club is short that amount. It is not a salary and is never added to one.

options_unpriced.mutual: a mutual option needs both sides to agree; /fa/ holds a fixed prior, not a price
options_unpriced.conditional: the condition is not on file; /fa/ holds a fixed prior, not a price
options_unpriced.no_projection: /fa/ carries no projection for this player
options_unpriced.no_strike: the option salary is not on file
options_unpriced.no_band: /fa/ has no price band for this row

copy.options_resolved_note: a resolved row's date is the night the pipeline first saw it, not a published date
copy.options_not_summed: salaries at stake print per row and are never added into a club figure
copy.options_none: No pending option or opt-out on this winter's free-agent class.
copy.options_later: Options in later seasons of long-term deals print apart under Later seasons, with the season on file and no decision date.
copy.options_later_lede: Options in later seasons of long-term deals, one row per option season, copied from the contract rows of the contract ledger: the option type, who holds it and the option-year salary where the curated file holds one.
copy.options_later_no_date: The decision winter is not on file: the stored season does not say whether the decision falls after that season or before it, so no decision date prints.
copy.options_later_none: No option in a later season of a long-term deal is on file for this club.
copy.options_later_terms: Terms only: nothing in this block is priced, and no salary here is added into a club figure
copy.options_source: the free-agent class rows (Spotrac, through fa_export, daily)
copy.farm_dollar_is: A farm dollar here is an expected value: the eFV expected surplus of an active prospect, in millions, on the clemens_2026 valuation set (its tier shape at the one free-agent $/WAR level the MLB leg also prices at) over its own seven-season window, priced through the platform's calibrated engine (calibration isotonic-real-v3-todaypriced-2026-10-09, prospect_surplus validated on data/surplus_backtest_real.json). It is the mean of a distribution whose 10th and 90th percentiles print on the row. Net of the signing bonus it is what the club roll-up sums.
copy.swartz_label: MLB Trade Rumors, Matt Swartz, published before settlement; present on 859 history rows, of which the a6 arm scored 808 on identical rows
copy.fa_profile_lede: Share of league free-agent dollars, by the winter each deal was signed. Realized spending, not a forecast.
copy.fa_profile_bands_note: Major-league deals only, each in the band of its nominal guarantee; minor-league deals carry no guarantee and are counted apart.
copy.fa_profile_resign_note: Of this club's free agents who signed a major-league deal, the share who signed back with this club.
copy.fa_profile_qo_note: Signings and departures whose row carries the qualifying-offer tag.
copy.fa_profile_share_basis: Nominal guarantees, the same dollars as the Spend by winter table, over the thirty clubs' total for the window; rank 1 is the largest.
copy.payroll_history_note: Spotrac's tax page for each season from 2016 to 2026 as cached, read without a fetch: tax payroll, payor tier, the season's threshold as that page prints it and Spotrac's estimated bill, with total payroll allocations from the season's payroll page where one is cached (2020 prints as Spotrac carries it, the shortened season's prorated cash). Realized figures, not a forecast; no line is drawn past the last season.

field_key.commitments.by_season: [season, contract_usd, n_contract, arb_projected_usd, n_arb, prearb_rule_usd, n_prearb, n_cliff]; n_unpriced is on the block; NO SUM of the three
field_key.contracts.rows: [key, name, pos, age, salSrc, aav_usd, signed_thru, ctrl_thru, ctrl_why, sur_npv_usd, salPath, options]; salPath cell [season, proj_usd, lo_usd, hi_usd, token, source, cliff]; option [season, holder, price_usd]

field_key.arbitration.realized.seasons: [season, n, actual_usd, ours_usd, ou_mkt_usd, ou_war_usd, war]; ou_mkt and ou_war are never combined

field_key.farm.ifa: class year -> [total_usd, signings, top_bonus, top_player, pool_pct_sum, implied_pool_usd, implied_n]

field_key.fa.fits: [key, name, pos, fit, need, window, afford, park, behavior]
field_key.fa.winters: [winter, n_in, spend_in_usd, aav_mean_usd, qo_in, n_out, guar_out_usd, league_dpw_usd, years_mix]
field_key.fa.realized.by_winter: [winter, n, n_covered, war_td, paid_td_usd, surplus_td_usd, realized_usd, n_complete]
field_key.farm.prospects: [key, name, pos, age, consensus_fv, efv, acq_method, acq_year, pick_overall, bonus_usd, slot_usd, cur_method, cur_year, surplus_mm, band_lo_mm, band_hi_mm, p_bust, net_mm, dollar_dvm_plus, eta_year, service_phase, on_40_man, options_left, rule5_exposed, tv_grade, cons_surplus_mm, cons_lo_mm, cons_hi_mm]; surplus_mm is the eFV expected surplus (trade board trade_value_mm, equal to the eFV export's surplus_mm); band_lo/hi are the row's p10/p90 on that basis and are never summed; net_mm = surplus_mm - bonus_usd / 1e6 and is the only column the leaf sums; cons_* are the PROSPX consensus-basis figures for the expander only
field_key.farm.graduates: [key, name, pos, debut_date, acq_method, acq_year, bonus_usd, dv_trade_value_mm, dv_realized_mm, control_thru, control_why, tv_trade_value_mm, tv_surplus_source, service_phase, career_war, wag_label, in_vets, dev_share, now_with]. The dv_* columns come from debuts_lite debuted_value (debuted_player_value) and the tv_* columns from the trade board: two engines on one row, each labelled, never summed. The control_thru/control_why pair is the current control window from the trade board's debuted row, else the /projections/ vet row, else null (never the at-debut window). The in_vets flag says whether /projections/ carries the player. arbitration_eval.claim: our SERVED estimator against the PUBLISHED pre-settlement Swartz projection, on settled figures, identical rows
arbitration_eval.statement: This model does not beat the MLB Trade Rumors / Matt Swartz projection. Measured on identical rows, Swartz is materially more accurate at every arbitration step. Reported as a NULL. The mechanism is not mysterious: Swartz prices the counting stats arbitration panels actually reward - home runs, RBI, saves, wins - and this champion deliberately excludes them because nothing in this pipeline projects them forward, which is what lets the same model serve a backtest and a forecast. Swartz is the better estimate of a KNOWN season; it is not available for an unplayed one.

what_this_page_does_not_claim: revenue: no source in the tree carries club revenue or operating income
franchise valuation: no source carries a valuation
attendance money: one season of home-game attendance exists in the game feeds and no history; no gate receipts
ticket prices: not sourced
local or national TV / RSN money: not sourced
central-fund distributions: not sourced
revenue-sharing payer or recipient status: which clubs receive revenue sharing is not sourceable; the QO tax tier for recipients prints as a league value only
minor-league payroll: not sourced
front-office and coaching salaries: not sourced
stadium debt: not sourced
actual CBT bills paid: only Spotrac's estimate for payors and the schedule computed here
2027+ bonus pools and IFA pool allocations as published: pools past 2026 are not on disk and IFA pools are implied from Spotrac percentages
service-time ground truth: the class token is inferred on most arbitration rows
a single projected payroll: three labelled segments only
a prospect or contract number recomputed through value_framework: every figure on the row layers is a copy of a served artifact (PROSPECT_ANCHOR_GATE 13.2)
a summed quantile or a combined residual: bands print per row, footers under a band column read not summed, ou_mkt and ou_war stay apart and the Swartz figure is a third quantity
a dollar cost basis for the trade channel: FV given up is the Trade Machine's currency
a per-graduate Grad-Contract Surplus: the org mean only is served
arbitration comps, filing figures, hearing outcomes or per-rung residual quantiles: none is on any served row

a served opt-out value on a contract row: player option seasons are priced as guaranteed by the salary path and folded as a probability by the trade board, and neither is an opt-out value; the options calendar quotes the /fa/ export's modelled value for this winter's pending opt-outs only, under that module's name
a sum of the salaries at stake in the options calendar: each prints on its own row

a decision date for an option in a later season of a long-term deal: the stored season does not say whether the decision falls after that season or before it, so the options calendar's Later seasons rows carry the season on file and no date
a rank or grade of clubs by farm finance beyond the v1 fin_* leaves
a betting or management figure: the ledger's only touches are two links
a free-agent spending forecast: the spend profile is realized spending by the winter each deal was signed, and the payroll history stops at the last season Spotrac's pages carry
